arguments.text: The exhibition should not place the plinth at the entrance because doing so would block the only wheelchair ramp.
arguments.title: Keep the only ramp clear

arguments.author: 0x622f6ff6cbc8136db351d5eaafad8ea1052fbac5
arguments.text: The west-side ramp is closed for the entire exhibition. Its existence therefore does not establish that a second accessible route is available.
arguments.title: The west ramp is closed

arguments.author: 0xdefac2cf8e82a845409614f9cf1fb35a994250b1
arguments.text: The exhibition may place the plinth at the entrance. A second wheelchair ramp is available on the west side, so the entrance ramp is not the only accessible route.
arguments.title: There is a second ramp

arguments.author: 0xdefac2cf8e82a845409614f9cf1fb35a994250b1
arguments.text: The exhibition should print a tactile route guide, helping visitors understand the accessible routes before they arrive.
arguments.title: Print a tactile route guide

challenges.basis: A closed ramp cannot support the claim that an alternative accessible route is available.
Allowing the plinth at the entrance directly opposes keeping it away from that entrance.
Printing a guide does not establish that blocking the only ramp is acceptable.
